Because all three share the same parameter labels and live in the same package, the body is almost certainly identical boilerplate assigning the four properties. The idiomatic Swift fix is to introduce a protocol (e.g., `PlaylistEntry`) that declares these four stored properties, then provide a default `init` in a protocol extension, eliminating the per-type duplication.
